scene: The warm dumpling sparkles with sweet steam.
picture: Side view of a bustling travel platform. On the far left, a glass-roofed trolley sits on rails. In the centre, the player in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat eats a glowing dumpling. Up high stands a brass spiral lift with open gates, while a wooden river barge floats tied on the far right.
shown: A gleaming glass-roofed trolley waiting on rails on the far left
A brass spiral lift with open lattice gates up high
A wooden river barge tied to a low pier on the far right
